summary: Creates a new `4D.CryptoKey` object encapsulating an encryption key pair
description: The 4D.CryptoKey.new() function creates a new 4D.CryptoKey object encapsulating an encryption key pair, based upon the settings object parameter. It allows to generate a new RSA or ECDSA key, or to load an existing key pair from a PEM definition.

params.name: settings
params.description: Settings to generate or load a key pair
